notes: 3D: drag a piece to move it (Shift+drag = up and down); pieces folded off it come along. Drag on empty space for a selection box (left to right = inside, right to left = touching). Clip toggle: on, a dragged piece climbs onto what's under it; off, pieces pass through. Orbit is now right- or middle-drag, Shift pans. Moves are 3D only.
